explanation: These are the core fatal error functions in V8. V8_Fatal is the main fatal error handler called by CHECK and FATAL macros. It prints error messages, optionally prints stack traces, and calls OS::Abort(). FatalProcessOutOfMemory handles out-of-memory conditions with special handling for embedder callbacks. FatalOOM and FatalNoSecurityImpact are simpler variants for specific use cases. All eventually lead to process termination via OS::Abort() or OS::ExitProcess().
